Avery_CS: Heads-up — ProtonHealth reserved pool goes live Tue 03/31. Need final quota alignment + autoscale bakeoff schedule. Can we sync infra and customer test windows?
Ravi_SRE: Got it. What peak QPS and steady-state RPS are they expecting? Any heavy embed requests?
Avery_CS: They projected 600 peak rps with spikes to 1.2k for 30s bursts. Mostly text-gen, ~1.1k tokens average. Embeddings low.
Diego_SE: For that profile we should run a 2-phase load test: 1) 2h soak at 600rps 2) 10x spike bursts (1.2k for 30s) repeated 6x. Want me to drop the k6 script in this thread?
Avery_CS: Yes please. Also confirm quota headroom and fallback model list (quantized variants) so customer UX degrades gracefully.
Ravi_SRE: Quota: we have 700 reserved by contract. Need a short-term bump to 1.5k for the bakeoff day or enable cross-pool burst. Fallback chain: redwood-m4-q4 -> redwood-m3-q8 -> hosted-small. Will validate compatibility.
Lina_Proton: Quick note from Proton: we require KMS-backed key for logs and want warm KV cache before traffic. We'll run our canary traffic from us-east-1.
Diego_SE: Copy. I'll add KMS flag to the warmup script and seed prefix cache for common prompts. k6 snippet: ```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'summarize:', max_tokens: 120}));
  sleep(0.1);
}
```
Avery_CS: Nice. Ravi — can you confirm autoscale policy tolerances? We want aggressive scale-up <30s for bursts but softer scale-down to avoid oscillation.
Ravi_SRE: Proposed: metric=token_out_per_min, scale_up_rate=3x within 30s, cooldown_down=10m, min_instances=4, max_instances=20. Will test in staging.
Lina_Proton: Also can we have an ops contact on-call during the bakeoff window? Prefer overlap 9–11pm UTC.
Avery_CS: I'll be on the call. @Ravi_SRE you?
Ravi_SRE: I can cover 9–11pm UTC. I'll create a temporary rota and add deploy-bot scheduled check-ins.
deploy-bot: scheduled: capacity-bakeoff-check at 2026-03-25T21:00:00Z (reminder + runbook link) :bell:
Diego_SE: One more ask — capture a short perf artifact (tail 1m p50/p95/p99) and a sample failed request body if any. We'll attach to the onboarding ticket.
Avery_CS: Great. I'll push the schedule to Proton and create the ORT ticket with artifacts checklist.
Lina_Proton: Thanks all, appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:
Ravi_SRE: I'll post staging results by EOD tomorrow and drop the final autoscale JSON here.
Avery_CS: Perfect — closing loop once Ravi posts the autoscale JSON and Diego seeds cache.
